summary: Okay...either Comcast throttled me (possibly) or my last mile is so bad (probable) that only installing when on campus. At home an update over FTP could take 20-25 minutes...Did it in like 12 on wireless at the office.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html: Okay...either Comcast throttled me (possibly) or my last mile is so bad (probable) that only installing when on campus. At home an update over FTP could take 20-25 minutes...Did it in like 12 on wireless at the office.
